extra_true.finding: Cold brew post has no Article schema or author/date byline.
Flores Bajawa has no Product markup despite being a product page with a price.
The Organization JSON-LD omits sameAs and contactPoint details; contact details also appear on the site.
Product offers omit URL and priceValidUntil, and do not mark up the listed 1kg prices.
The home page hero image has no lazy-loading attribute.
The blog index provides no excerpts under its post links.
Blog posts do not link to /shop/ or /subscriptions/.
The home page body copy omits links to /shop/, /subscriptions/ and /visit/.
The site has no Open Graph or Twitter card tags and no favicon links.

notes: All 20 planted issues were found with the required page and specific problem. Counted the audit’s 25 numbered findings once each; the wrong Kintamani title length is a factual discrepancy.
